description: Source code for configuration procedure handling in a radio system, including notifier classes, request handling, and state management.

classes.name: p5_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy notifier class for P5 responses that reports errors when called.

classes.name: error_indication_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy notifier class for error indications that reports errors when called.

classes.name: p5_operational_change_request_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy notifier class for operational change requests, always returns false on start request.

methods.name: configuration_procedure::send_param_request
methods.description: Sends a parameter request and reports error if in invalid state.

methods.name: configuration_procedure::send_config_request
methods.description: Sends a configuration request, updates cell config if not running, and changes state accordingly.

methods.name: configuration_procedure::send_start_request
methods.description: Starts the cell if in configured state, otherwise reports error.

methods.name: configuration_procedure::send_stop_request
methods.description: Stops the cell if in running state, otherwise reports error.

methods.name: configuration_procedure::update_cell_config
methods.description: Updates internal cell configuration with provided message.
